notes: Your dump settled it: all 45 profile-indexed getters return -1 permanently. This van does not put gear, rpm, coolant, fuel, tyre pressures, doors, seatbelts, ambient temperature or any of the rest on the bus. Six readings are real - road speed, steering angle, indicators, headlights, battery voltage, and the sixteen parking sensors - plus reverse, which DWM already gets from the deck's audio-duck broadcast. So the dashboard is now built for those six instead of showing seventeen dashes. Two zones, not three. DRIVE has the speed readout, a centre-anchored steering bar that swings as you turn the wheel, and chips for lights, reverse and battery. PARKING is the whole right side: your van drawn from above with all sixteen sensors placed where they physically sit, filling and turning amber then red as something gets closer, with a STOP / CLOSE / CLEAR readout and reversing guides that bend with the steering. Turn the wheel while parked to confirm the CAN link is alive - steering is the one reading that moves with the engine off. The tile deletions are cosmetic only: nothing was removed from the AIDL layer, Dump CAN getters still sweeps all 64 on demand, and if a different car profile in the head unit ever answers those getters the readings can come straight back. Polling was also cut from 16 getters a second to 8, since the other 45 were proven dead.
